## Purpose

Describe the problem and the bounded change.

## Evidence

Link retained artifacts and distinguish measured, derived, assumed, user-reported,
and unknown quantities. When evidence is required, state the representative real
input, target environment, measurement method, observed result, limitations, and
stop/proceed decision.

## Verification

List correctness checks separately from performance evidence.
